notes:
TCC Website 0.13.2: main menu helpers and "Sermons" in the admin menu

The last two church snippets in Code Snippets are now features of the plugin, each with its own switch and help:

- Main menu helpers (was snippet 31): shows the red Watch Online button only on Sunday from 8:30am to 12 noon, makes the drop-down panels the same height, puts the cursor in the search box when Search is clicked, keeps the menu buttons showing in windows about 981 to 995 pixels wide, and closes the phone menu when a window changes to the phone layout. A straight copy of the snippet.
- Sermons, not Posts, in the admin menu (was snippet 7): calls posts "Sermons" in the left-hand admin menu and in "+ New" on the top bar. It now checks that "+ New > Post" is there before renaming it, which the snippet did not.

The help no longer asks volunteers to keep the old snippets: on staging they are in the Snippets Trash, and a copy of each is in the repository's snippets folder.

Checked on staging with both snippets switched off: all 22 features working, the header at 1920, 1440, 995, 768 and 375 wide, and the admin menu. All 145 Playground tests pass.
